### Item 1 — what the user expresses, and how the simulator behaves
- Opening line per script: "move your car loan autopay to the new checking account and have it come out on the 20th." Target object: the one car loan (Honda Accord refinance, loan number ends 8826). Action boundary: (a) change the autopay paying account to the new Premier Checking ending 8561, (b) due day from the 5th to the 20th. The customer never raises the August payment ("you never bring it up yourself").
- Identity: gives mobile 3365550186 when asked who he is; DOB 1981-03-22 + SSN last4 8417 when asked to confirm (ZIP 27408 if one more is needed). Verification with phone + DOB + SSN4 returned "Identity verified ... (3 detail(s) matched this attempt)".
- Authorisation modes: agent may make the catch-up payment (conditional: only after the agent says something must be paid first; he then says pay "whatever is needed from the new Premier Checking account ending in 8561 today", names no figure, does not question the split) and the due-date change ("happy for the agent to make the payment and the due date change"). Autopay switching is user-executed: he runs the cancel step when handed it, then the enrol step when handed it, using the Premier account ending 8561. Rate: "whatever discount you are entitled to", leaves figures to the agent. Ends when the enrolment from the new account succeeds and the agent confirms.
- The simulator only conveys needs, responds under if/else, and executes user tools the agent hands over; it pushes nothing forward on its own.

### Item 4 — scored parameters, formula in words, inputs, final values
Step 1 — post_installment_payment_660c6229:
- installment_due_date = loan's next payment date: installment_remainder clause 1 "The installment paid is the one whose installment date is the loan's next payment date as shown on the loan record" -> 2026-08-05.
- Standing credit: clause 2/3 "sum of the amounts of the scheduled payments already applied toward the same installment date, less the amount of any such payment that was later returned unpaid ... the payment named by the most recent payment reversal": 438.01 (ea9422da) - 438.01 (named by the latest reversal 1844e7fa) = 0.00. Remainder = 438.01 - 0.00 = 438.01 ("never below zero").
- Draw: installment_payment_posted_balance_limit "When that account's ledger balance is lower than the installment remainder ... the payment is that ledger balance; otherwise the payment is the installment remainder." Premier ledger 4382.16 >= 438.01 -> amount 438.01.

- Principal from ledger (clause 2): 21480.00 - 5906.22 (sum of principal portions of all 19 payments) + 330.30 (reversal) = 15904.08 (equals record).
- Interest (installment_payment_interest_to_credit_date): 15904.08 x 8.24 / 100 / 365 (payment_application_terms: Auto Refinance day-count 365) x days from 2026-07-06 (not counted) through 2026-08-14 (counted) = 39 days -> 140.0256... -> rounded once half-up 140.03.
- Split (installment_payment_split_order; application order "fees, then interest, then principal"): fees 25.00; interest min(140.03, 413.01) = 140.03; principal 438.01 - 25.00 - 140.03 = 272.98.
- next_payment_due_date: payment_crediting clause 5 "the next payment due date then advances one month to the payment due day" -> 2026-09-05; days_past_due 0 (delinquency_and_chargeoff clause 1 "return to zero when every past-due installment is satisfied"; 2026-09-05 is in the future).
- counterparty_account_id = 7d2ab1e4 (the active checking; customer names it).
Step 2 — change_due_day_df9bec35: new_due_day 20; next_payment_due_date: due_day_change_policy clause 5 "The next due date moves to the new day in the month of the current next payment due date" -> current next due after step 1 is 2026-09-05 -> 2026-09-20.

- autopay_source_account_id = af221038 ("as shown as the autopay paying account in the auto loan lookup").
- Rate before discounts (cancellation_rate_before_discounts): 8.24 + (0.25 autopay + 0.25 relationship, capped at 0.50) = 8.74 (rate_discount_parameters, Auto Refinance: 0.25 / 0.25 / cap 0.50 / floor 4.49 / removed on cancellation "yes"). ### Item 6 — problem tree walked from the visible documents alone
Root R: enrol the loan in autopay from Premier 7d2ab1e4 (plus the requested due-day change D).
- R needs "no enrollment standing": autopay_enrollment clause 3 "A new enrollment is recorded only on a loan with no enrollment standing; where an enrollment still stands, the new enrollment is not recorded. When the borrower is moving autopay to a different checking account, the enrollment from the new account is recorded only once no enrollment stands on the loan." Query: `autopay_enrolled True`, source af221038 -> NOT satisfied. Which action: cancel_autopay_a2c51ad3 ("One call ends the standing enrollment: the loan is marked as not enrolled"). Also autopay_enrollment_basis clause 5 "An autopay debit returned unpaid is handled as a returned payment, and autopay stays enrolled" confirms the return did not end the enrollment. -> sub-problem C (cancel).
- R needs "no installment past due": enrollment_autopay_discount_gate "Entry condition. The loan has no installment past due when autopay is enrolled ... where it has one, the enrollment is not recorded." Query: `days_past_due 9`, next due 2026-08-05 -> NOT satisfied. Which action: past_due_installment_payment / post_installment_payment_660c6229 ("pay the earliest past-due installment"), which "records the next installment due date and the days past due given". -> sub-problem P (catch-up payment).
- C needs D recorded first when the borrower also asks for a new due day: autopay_cancellation clause 3 "When a borrower who is moving autopay to a different checking account also asks for a new due day, the due date change is recorded before the standing enrollment is cancelled". The customer did ask for day 20 -> D precedes C.
- D needs "active with no installment past due": due_day_change_policy clause 3 "The loan must be active with no installment past due, as shown on the loan record." Query: dpd 9 -> NOT satisfied; action P again. Other D gates hold (range, size 15 <= 15, no earlier change).
- P needs: loan open (payment_crediting clause 3 "active or delinquent": active -> holds); paying account active checking (7d2ab1e4 active -> holds); no further prerequisite in the visible KB.
- C needs: nothing further beyond the D-ordering clause (retired clause "the loan must be active or delinquent" is marked no longer in force; the loan is active anyway).
Resulting problem list and order: P (catch-up payment) -> D (due-day change) -> C (cancel old enrollment, user) -> R (enrol from new account, user). Dependency edges: R<-C, R<-P, D<-P, C<-D. The same order is also written as a whole in the SOP doc autopay_source_change_sop ("Steps 1..4" and "Why the order is fixed"); every hop is also borne individually by the documents quoted above.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what the customer asked" (just cancel and enrol, or just enrol, plus change the due day) is excluded by visible clauses: enrollment_autopay_discount_gate entry condition (no installment past due) and due_day_change_policy clause 3 (no installment past due), with dpd 9 on record; autopay_enrollment clause 3 (no enrollment standing) with `autopay_enrolled True`.
- Closest alternative object/action — waive the returned payment fee 24685022 as bank error: excluded by returned_fee_closed_account_test "the returned payment fee is PCB's error when ... a PCB checking account whose closing date ... is earlier than the debit's posting date. It is not PCB's error when ... the paying account was still open on the debit's posting date". Debit posted 2026-08-05; af221038 closed 2026-08-10 (later) -> not PCB's error; returned_fee_waiver_amount "Nothing waived ... when the fee is not PCB's error". Courtesy waiver excluded: fee_waiver_rules clause 6 "returned payment fees are never waived as a courtesy". Fee therefore stays in fees due (25.00) and is paid first by the catch-up payment.
- Late charge alternative: none on ledger; NC grace 15 days (late_charge_schedule_by_state), last grace day 2026-08-20 > today -> late_charge_assessment "not yet".
- Alternative draw amounts: monthly payment + fee (463.01) excluded by posted_balance_limit "The draw is the installment remainder at most"; standing credit using the reversal amount 330.30 (remainder 330.30) excluded by installment_remainder clause 2/3 ("less the amount of any such payment that was later returned unpaid"; "Its amount comes off") — the payment's amount 438.01, not the reversal's.
- Alternative interest start: 2026-08-05 (date of the returned debit) excluded by the loan record last_payment_date 2026-07-06 and returned_payment_handling clause 3 "the last payment date returns to the date it held before the payment".
- Alternative ordering: C before D excluded by autopay_cancellation clause 3; D before P excluded by due_day_change_policy clause 3; R before C excluded by autopay_enrollment clause 3.
- Alternative next due after D: 2026-08-20 (month of the pre-payment next due) excluded because D runs after P; due_day_change_policy clause 5 reads "the current next payment due date", which is 2026-09-05 after P.
- Alternative cancel APR "recorded APR plus autopay discount" gives 8.49 here too (no divergence in this world); rebuild basis is the cancellation_new_apr_and_floor witness. Alternative relationship loss (old Private Client now closed) excluded by "A qualifying account closed later still counts".
- Alternative enrolment discount (no autopay discount because the loan was past due at the start of the call) excluded: the gate reads dpd at enrolment time, which is 0 after P (SOP "the enrollment reads those days past due when it decides whether the autopay discount is added").

#### What changed on the visible surface for this task
1. The enrollment past-due condition is now a value gate, not a block. enrollment_autopay_discount_gate: "The loan has no installment past due when autopay is enrolled, so the enrollment carries the autopay discount. #### Counter-proof
- "Do only what was asked" (cancel, enrol, change the due day): the due-day change is refused by due_day_change_policy clause 3 while dpd is 9; the cancellation cannot precede the due-day change (autopay_cancellation Policy 3); so the payment must come first. - Alternative "enrol now at 8.49 without discount, pay later": excluded because the due-day change the customer wants must precede the cancellation and needs the loan current, so P is in the call; the same-call rule then fixes P before R.
